about_the_game:
If you’ve enjoyed your time tending the bar, decorating cozy corners, this Supporter Pack is a warm way to say “cheers” to the devs at Bitcover Studio

By picking it up, you’ll unlock a new exclusive bar theme, a fresh look that brings a touch of charm and personality to your space. Think of it as your bar’s own glow-up moment 🌿✨

Note: This DLC is a token of appreciation and doesn’t affect gameplay. But it does add a little extra charm to your space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 @ 3.2 GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
